tickets.title: Open new client account
tickets.text: Open a joint taxable brokerage account for Rowan Bramblequill and Lila Nettlewhisk at Velvet Acorn Custody to receive monthly surplus from the new household checking arrangement.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to set up the joint taxable account, with follow-up due July 12, 2024.

tickets.title: Obtain marriage documentation for account records
tickets.text: Obtain the marriage certificate and Lila Nettlewhisk’s identification documents for updating the joint brokerage account paperwork and household profile records.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain the marriage documentation for account records by June 28, 2024.

tickets.title: Complete marriage-based beneficiary review
tickets.text: Complete a beneficiary review for Rowan Bramblequill’s IRA, Roth IRA, employer retirement plan, term life policy, and group life coverage using the updated marital status.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to complete that marriage-based beneficiary review by July 17, 2024.

tickets.title: Guide benefits enrollment decision and submission
tickets.text: Use the benefits enrollment workflow to compare health, dental, vision, HSA, disability, life insurance, and payroll deduction options for Rowan Bramblequill and Lila Nettlewhisk, and prepare recommendations for their post‑marriage elections.

subTasks.title: Collect benefits materials and key enrollment constraints
subTasks.text: Request the current benefits guide, plan comparison sheets, premium schedule, employer contribution details, enrollment window, and any life event documentation needed for eligibility.

subTasks.title: Review plan fit and planning tradeoffs
subTasks.text: Compare health, disability, life insurance, HSA/FSA, retirement plan, deferred compensation, and equity-related elections as applicable. Note cash flow impact, tax implications, beneficiary needs, and coordination with existing coverage.

subTasks.title: Prepare enrollment recommendations for client discussion
subTasks.text: Summarize proposed elections, open questions, documents needed, and any items requiring confirmation from the employer benefits team or outside tax professional.

subTasks.title: Confirm submission and retain evidence
subTasks.text: After the client submits elections, request confirmation pages or benefit summaries and save them to the client record for future planning reference.

tickets.evidence: They agreed to the employer benefits election review, with follow-up due July 10, 2024.

tickets.title: Reconcile equity vesting records
tickets.text: Reconcile the restricted stock unit vesting schedule for Rowan Bramblequill with the equity portal export to ensure accurate cash‑flow and tax withholding projections.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to reconcile the equity vesting records by July 22, 2024.

tickets.title: Address custodian address and portal access issue
tickets.text: Resolve the missing address update on custodian statements and ensure Lila Nettlewhisk receives the household portal invitation, updating the joint household profile accordingly.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to address the custodian address and portal access issue by July 3, 2024.

tickets.title: Coordinate estate document updates
tickets.text: Coordinate updates to Rowan Bramblequill’s estate documents to reflect Lila Nettlewhisk’s role, the two properties, and revised decision‑maker designations.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to estate document coordination by August 2, 2024.

tickets.title: Coordinate residency and tax matters
tickets.text: Coordinate with CPA Sasha Cloudpuddle on the Oregon‑to‑Washington move, updating mailing address, legal residence, payroll withholding, and property reflections in planning records for Rowan Bramblequill and Lila Nettlewhisk.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to residency and tax coordination, with follow-up due July 26, 2024.
